bosses.name: Tuten'kash
bosses.general: Called by the gong after spider waves: Web Spray stuns, a curse and Virulent Poison.
bosses.tank: Hold the spiders near the gong, then Tuten'kash.
bosses.healer: Cure poison and remove the curse.
bosses.dps: Kill the spiders, then the big one.

bosses.name: Mordresh Fire Eye
bosses.general: Fire caster: Fireball and Fire Nova.
bosses.healer: Heal the nova on the melee.
bosses.dps: Interrupt Fireball; melee watch the nova.

bosses.name: Glutton
bosses.general: Disease Cloud around him, frenzies at low health.
bosses.tank: Plain tank, cooldown at the end.
bosses.healer: Cure disease; more healing in the frenzy.

bosses.name: Ragglesnout
bosses.general: Rare quilboar priest: Shadow Bolt and a mind control.

bosses.name: Amnennar the Coldbringer
bosses.general: Lich: Frost Nova on the melee, Frostbolt, and he calls Frozen Spectres partway through.
bosses.tank: Pick up the spectres when they come.
bosses.healer: Dispel Frost Nova on the tank, heal the frost damage.
bosses.dps: Kill the spectres, then him; frost resistance helps.
